title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Monday, 28 September 2026
description: Today's stories: a frantic ten-day stretch of AI model launches and steep Alibaba Cloud price cuts, a magnitude-3.9 earthquake in Victoria's High Country ahead of this week's RBA rate decision, the opening of a new trauma-accredited ward at Cairns Hospital, and Burleigh Heads Library's return to full service ahead of the BLEACH Festival. 오늘의 브리핑은 영어에 이어 한국어로도 제공됩니다.
